      • setPartsOfSpeech

        @Deprecated
public void setPartsOfSpeech(java.util.List<PartOfSpeech> partsOfSpeech)
        Deprecated. use termPartsOfSpeech
        Converts term parts of speech to export tags: adjective → ADJ, adposition → ADP, adverb → ADV, auxiliary → AUX, coordinating conjunction → CCONJ, determiner → DET, interjection → INTJ, noun → NOUN, numeral → NUM, particle → PRT, pronoun → PRON, proper noun → PROPN, subordinating conjunction → SCONJ, verb → VERB, other → X.

        The mapping follows the published API values (glossary terms use other, glossary export uses X) and the Universal Dependencies semantics, where X means "other". It has not been confirmed by a live Crowdin API test.

        Parameters:
        partsOfSpeech - term parts of speech
